sentence: She wants to try a class at the local college this summer.
synonym: take a course at the nearby college
synonymNote: 意思相同，都表示去附近大学上课体验课程

distractors.word: teach a class at the local college
distractors.note: teach是教课，不是去上课体验，意思相反

distractors.word: visit a class at the local college
distractors.note: visit只是参观，不含主动学习报名的意思

distractors.word: skip a class at the local college
distractors.note: skip是跳过/逃课，与尝试上课意思完全相反
